blurb: Welcome to the Red Barn Convention Center located in the Heart of Adams County just off state route 32 in Winchester, Ohio. Our complex is situated across roughly 80 acres, which includes a 70 spot RV Park, and 2 state of the art auditoriums. Stop by most weekends March - December for a wide variety of genres including Country, Classic Country, Bluegrass & Gospel in a great intimate setting.
